{{Quote|So, to celebrate, we spent the next week and a half bar hopping around Mandrine.|The memoirs of Captain Scarlet Bloodhawk|<ref name="Polyhedron59" />}}
'''Mandrine''' was a celestial body located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]]. It featured several [[Cantina/Legends|bars]], including [[Maizie's]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crew of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Capri Nitari]]'' visited Mandrine's bars to celebrate a successful [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trafficking run. At Maizie's, the vessel's [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Scarlet Bloodhawk]] met the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kelly Vermillion]] and his companions [[Tyric (Shaliz'Na)|Tyric]] and [[Nana]], who became involved in a bar fight against [[Kronus]] and his thugs, which resulted in Kronus's [[Death/Legends|death]]. Bloodhawk later visited the same bar on Mandrine on several occasions.

==Description==
Mandrine was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Polyhedron59" /> located in the [[Mandrine system/Legends|Mandrine system]], a part of the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Unlicensedstart}}
{{Quote|Maizie's was really hopping with some bird-man named Tyric playing the synthesizer, and the light displays were going full blast. I was enjoying it&hellip;until Kronus and his goons showed up and started a brawl.|The memoirs of Captain Scarlet Bloodhawk|<ref name="Polyhedron59" />}}
[[File:KellyVermillionAndGang-Polyhedron63.png|thumb|right|280px|Kelly Vermillion (leftmost) and his companions Tyric (second from right) and Nana (rightmost) visited Mandrine during the Galactic Civil War.]]
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after completing the profitable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trafficking run known along the [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], the crew of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Capri Nitari]]'', which included [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Scarlet Bloodhawk]], [[Haynes]], and [[Shandar (smuggler)|Shandar]], visited Mandrine to celebrate their success. The trio visited the celestial body's [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] for a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] and a half, eventually making a stop at [[Maizie's]].<ref name="Polyhedron59" />

The [[Human/Legends|Human]]/[[Orlak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kelly Vermillion]] and his companions, the [[Shaliz'Na]] [[Tyric (Shaliz'Na)|Tyric]] and the [[Homanan]] [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifter]] [[Nana]], were also present on Mandrine at that [[Time/Legends|time]]. While Bloodhawk was at Maizie's, Haynes encountered Nana, who had assumed the form of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Later, the captain met Vermilion and Tyric at the bar, before [[Kronus]] and his group of underlings initiated a brawl. Eventually, Tyric [[Death/Legends|killed]] Kronus with one of the thug's [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].<ref name="Polyhedron59" />

Bloodhawk encountered the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Justice (bounty hunter)|Justice]] and his companion, [[Truth]], at Maizie's on another occasion. As the captain was about to visit the bar once again, she described her first meeting with Vermillion and his crew at the Mandrine establishment in her memoirs.<ref name="Polyhedron59" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|''[&hellip;]'' I had a call from my buddy Haynes who said there was a problem at the starport, a wookie ''[sic]'' throwing its weight around, nosing around our ship.|The memoirs of Captain Scarlet Bloodhawk|<ref name="Polyhedron59" />}}
Several bars were scattered across Mandrine's surface, including Maizie's. Mandrine also had a spaceport, and the celestial body was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by several [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]].<ref name="Polyhedron59" />
{{Unlicensedend}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mandrine was introduced in "[[The New Rogues Gallery: Unsung Heroes of the Rebellion]]," a [[roleplaying game]] source article authored by [[Joe Littrell]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Polyhedron 59|fifty-ninth issue]] of the ''[[Polyhedron]]'' magazine in [[May]] [[1991]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Polyhedron59" /> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

However, [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of Mandrine to be canonical with respect to the Legends continuity.<ref name="Fry" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Mandrine system, and therefore Mandrine itself, in grid square T-10.<ref name="TEA" />
